_comment: The goal race and the training block built around it. All values are examples. Override the date with VITE_RACE_DATE. The goal tiers below are illustrative round numbers, not anyone's real targets.
_goalsComment: Three tiers, because one target is either too soft to train against or too brittle to race against. Coach trains to the realistic tier; the A-goal is auditioned at tune-up races; the floor is what still counts as a good day.

goals.label: A-goal · stretch
goals.note: Audition it at the tune-up races. Earn it, do not assume it.

goals.label: Realistic · target
goals.note: What Coach trains toward. Every marathon-pace session anchors here.

goals.label: Floor · safe result
goals.note: The safety net if race day goes sideways. Still a good day.
